title: erysimum bocconei var. nemorale
intro: Erysimum bocconei var. nemorale, commonly known as Wood Bleeding Heart, is a plant species in the Brassicaceae family, characterized by its unique ability to secrete a red sap when injured. The health benefits of Erysimum bocconei var. nemorale include its potential in reducing inflammation and improving wound healing due to its antimicrobial and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use in treating skin conditions, such as acne and eczema, and its potential in reducing pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Erysimum bocconei var. nemorale include isothiocyanates, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
